aiInsightSummary: Extensive plaster and paint failure on ceiling and walls with fallen debris on floor.
Ceiling and upper walls show signs consistent with long-term water damage and risk of further collapse.
Window frames and surrounding plaster are degraded but window glass appears intact.
Floor is covered with heavy debris creating trip hazards and possible structural floor damage.
Electrical outlets appear present; no exposed live wiring visible but surrounding wall damage is significant.

recommendedActions.description: Large areas of plaster detachment and staining on ceiling; loose debris on floor indicates previous collapse.
recommendedActions.action: Evacuate room until a structural contractor inspects. Remove loose plaster, locate and repair leak source, and repair/replace ceiling framing and finish.

recommendedActions.description: Heavy fallen plaster and rubble covering floor creating trip hazards and possible subfloor damage.
recommendedActions.action: Clear debris with PPE, assess flooring/subfloor for damage, repair or reinforce subfloor as needed before reusing room.

recommendedActions.issueType: Walls - peeling paint & plaster loss, mold risk
recommendedActions.description: Extensive paint and plaster delamination; potential moisture intrusion and mold growth in affected areas.
recommendedActions.action: Test for moisture and mold. Remove damaged plaster, dry and remediate mold if present, then replaster and repaint with moisture-resistant materials.

recommendedActions.description: Window surrounds and frame show degraded plaster and seal failure; could allow water and air infiltration.
recommendedActions.action: Inspect window seals and frames. Repair/replace damaged frame components and reseal to restore weatherproofing.

recommendedActions.issueType: Electrical outlet condition near damaged wall
recommendedActions.description: Outlet(s) visible but located within significantly damaged wall area; no exposed live wiring noted.
recommendedActions.action: Have a licensed electrician inspect outlets and wiring after wall repairs. Replace any outlets or covers compromised by moisture or impact.

detectedIssues.description: Extensive peeling, staining and detached plaster on ceiling; evidence of previous collapse and active deterioration.
detectedIssues.recommendation: Immediate structural assessment. Remove loose material, identify/repair moisture source, and repair ceiling framing and finishes.

detectedIssues.description: Large amount of plaster and rubble on floor from ceiling/wall failure; major trip hazard and possible subfloor impact.
detectedIssues.recommendation: Do not occupy room until debris is cleared. Remove rubble wearing PPE, inspect and repair flooring/subfloor as needed.

detectedIssues.description: Widespread paint peeling and plaster delamination on side walls; likely moisture-related and may harbor mold.
detectedIssues.recommendation: Assess moisture levels and check for mold. Remove damaged plaster, dry area, remediate mold if present, then replaster and repaint.

detectedIssues.description: Plaster and frame around window are degraded; seals likely compromised though glass appears intact.
detectedIssues.recommendation: Inspect window frame and seals. Repair or replace damaged frame components and reseal to prevent water ingress.

detectedIssues.description: Electrical outlet visible on left wall surrounded by damaged plaster; no exposed wiring or burn marks observed.
detectedIssues.recommendation: Have a licensed electrician inspect outlet and wiring after wall repairs; replace outlet or cover if moisture or damage present.

areas.name: Ceiling
areas.note: Large plaster loss and staining; possible structural compromise.

areas.name: Walls
areas.note: Widespread peeling and delamination; moisture and mold risk.

areas.name: Windows
areas.note: Frame and surrounds degraded; resealing recommended.

areas.note: Heavy debris covering floor; trip hazard and possible subfloor damage.
